meta.title: A Toy Converter with Adaptive Dead-Time Control

items.text: This synthetic paper proposes an adaptive dead-time controller for a small buck converter. A bench prototype reaches an efficiency of 94 percent at full load, two points above a fixed dead-time baseline.
Keywords: buck converter, dead time, efficiency
Fixed dead time wastes energy because the body diode conducts longer than needed at light load. We therefore measure the switching node and shorten the dead time cycle by cycle.
The controller improves efficiency on one prototype, but it was not tested across temperature or with other power devices.
